function.name: reelix_movies
function.description: Look up movies and TV series on Reelix. Use this when the user asks to search for a title, wants details about a movie or series, asks who is in the cast, or wants availability/resources. Start with action=search (returns structured JSON). Then call action=details with the subjectId for a specific title: that sends the banner image and returns name, rating, type, genre, and description for a recap. Use action=cast, action=resources, or action=seasons only after you have a subjectId. Never invent titles that were not returned. Do not mention or invent download links.

action.description: search | details | resources | cast | seasons. Default search.

query.description: Search query for action=search, for example Inception or Breaking Bad.

subjectId.description: Numeric Reelix subject id from a search result. Required for details, resources, cast, and seasons.

type.description: movie or series. Helps pick the cast route. Optional.

page.description: Search or resources page number. Default 1.
